cross_source_lessons: Exact source lineage and processing state must be modeled separately from numeric measurements.
Compiled-grid coverage, survey footprint coverage, and raw-ping insonification are three different booleans.
Raw does not mean corrected, and higher resolution does not guarantee higher accuracy.
Instrument response correction and data availability/gap semantics are separate nuisance layers.
Custodian statements may calibrate provenance and coverage logic without being treated as target evidence.
Negative controls and noncoverage confirmations are first-class calibration assets.
